title: Home guide: shadows and distance
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 17 (Home practical guide and safety card: torch shadows (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how the size of a shadow changes.
equipment: A torch, a small toy and a wall
Tissue paper, a clear bag, a book
safety: Never shine the torch into anyone's eyes
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Make the room dim. Stand the toy between the torch and the wall.
Put the toy 10 cm from the torch. Measure the shadow's height on the wall.
Move the toy to 20 cm, then 30 cm, and measure each time.
Then shine the torch through tissue, a clear bag and a book. Which makes a shadow?
